policy.display: image and frontImage are fitted to their photo frames without cropping, while existing focal positions are preserved
policy.source_export: New fixed-size files must contain the sharp entire original image over a soft copy of the same image in spare space
policy.old_exports: Any pixels discarded in older hard-cropped WebP must be regenerated from the documented original; css object-fit cannot restore them
policy.limitations: Metadata flags are leads, not proof of a bad composition. Missing frontImage is not necessarily an error for all place tiers; human editorial framing review is necessary.
